title: Liliata rutilantium te confessorum turma circumdet: iubilantium te virginum chorus excipiat.
html_source: Latin for “May the troop of confessors, glowing like lilies, surround you. May the choir of virgins, jubilant, take you in.” This is from the Prayers for the Dying in the Catholic Layman’s Missal.

anchor.text: Liliata rutilantium te confessorum turma circumdet: iubilantium te virginum chorus excipiat.
anchor.prefix: e ghostcandle to light her agony. Ghostly light on the tortured face. Her hoarse loud breath rattling in horror, while all prayed on their knees. Her eyes on me to strike me down.
anchor.suffix:
